articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring dramatically improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a significantly expanded context window. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts in several fields.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Sets New Marks on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which achieves state-of-the-art results on SWE-Bench Verified and real-world agentic software engineering tasks, completing multi-file refactors and end-to-end feature implementations with minimal human guidance. The model integrates tightly with Google Cloud's developer tooling, signaling an escalating competition with OpenAI and Anthropic in the AI-for-code space.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Facility
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the start of paid commercial deployments of its Figure 02 humanoid robot at BMW's Spartanburg manufacturing plant, performing bin-picking, parts transfer, and inspection tasks alongside human workers. The deployment marks one of the first revenue-generating humanoid robotics contracts in automotive manufacturing and validates the viability of general-purpose humanoid form factors in structured industrial settings.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Completion in Live Demo
articles.summary: Tesla showcased a live demonstration of its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot performing unsupervised household chores including laundry folding, dish sorting, and object retrieval based on natural language commands. The demo leveraged an on-device vision-language-action model, though independent observers noted the tasks were conducted in a controlled environment and real-world robustness remains unproven.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration Framework for Enterprise Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic released a production-grade orchestration framework that allows Claude models to autonomously chain tool calls, manage state across multi-step workflows, and integrate with enterprise APIs with built-in guardrails and audit logging. The framework targets regulated industries like finance and healthcare where traceability of AI agent actions is a compliance requirement, and includes a novel constitutional-AI-based permission escalation system.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production on A14 2nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed it has entered high-volume manufacturing on its N2 (2nm) gate-all-around transistor process, roughly one quarter ahead of its original timeline, with initial production allocated to Apple and Nvidia. The node delivers an estimated 25% performance improvement or 30% power reduction over N3E, and is expected to underpin the next generation of AI training and inference accelerators shipping in late 2026.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act, targeting major foundation model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta to assess adherence to transparency, risk assessment, and systemic risk reporting requirements. Companies face potential fines up to 7% of global revenue for non-compliance, and the audits are being closely watched as a precedent for AI regulation worldwide.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Next-Gen Atlas with Dexterous Manipulation for Logistics
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, backed by Hyundai, revealed an updated electric Atlas platform with redesigned multi-fingered hands capable of manipulating irregular packages, operating door handles, and using standard human tools. The robot is being piloted in Hyundai's logistics centers for mixed-palletizing tasks, combining whole-body mobility with fine motor manipulation in a commercially targeted humanoid platform.
